opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000. Usual grant range: £250,000 – £1 million

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research-intensive universities and research institutions undertaking internationally competitive research. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and major equipment to enable high-quality research and improve research infrastructure. Two-stage application process, two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000. Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority managing sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Grants towards conservation and restoration work, interpretation, and education spaces at sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance with public access and engagement. Two-stage application process, two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000. Usual grant range: £50,000 – £500,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority, fully accredited under the Museum Accreditation Scheme, holding a permanent collection of national significance. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Grants to improve the display and interpretation of nationally significant collections, generally for refurbishing or creating new galleries and education/learning spaces. Two-stage application process, two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000. Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority, fully accredited under the Archive Service Accreditation Scheme, holding a permanent collection of national significance. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Grants to collection storage facilities and research, education or interpretation spaces for libraries and archives caring for nationally significant collections. Two-stage application process, two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000. Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority working with disability; if applicable at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment and equipment helping people with disabilities to live more independently, particularly projects on training, employment and supported housing. Two-stage application process, two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000. Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority working in mental health; if applicable at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment and equipment for charities working in mental health, with emphasis on training, employment and supported housing. Two-stage application process, two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000. Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority providing care and services for older people; if applicable at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment and equipment for organisations providing care and services for older people, particularly those with neurodegenerative conditions or who are isolated. Two-stage application process, two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000. Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or hospices operating within the NHS providing excellent care to patients and families; if applicable at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment and equipment for hospices and palliative care organisations. Two-stage application process, two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000. Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority focussed on professional performance, with performing arts constituting the vast majority of activities. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve training and education facilities for performing arts organisations, generally for building/refurbishment of these facilities and occasionally specialist equipment. Two-stage application process, two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000. Usual grant range: £250,000 – £750,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent), local authority or university displaying scientific or natural history collections of national significance; fully accredited under the Museum Accreditation Scheme if applicable. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve public engagement with science through the history of science, generally for refurbishing or creating new galleries and education/learning spaces. Two-stage application process, two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for special schools and colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000. Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority supporting special schools and colleges for children and young people with special educational needs; if applicable at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment and equipment supporting pupils at secondary level to develop skills for employment or independent living after school or college. Follows the Health & Disability programme guidance. Two-stage application process, two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for secondary schools & sixth form colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000. Maximum grant amount: £100,000. Usual grant range: £15,000 – £50,000 (equipment), £15,000 – £100,000 (new build and refurbishment)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: High-achieving state-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges with at least two years of exam results and good Ofsted/Estyn/HMIE/ETI rating. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve teaching at GCSE and A-Level of subjects needing specialist spaces and equipment (science, computer science, design & technology, art, languages, music, performing arts). One-stage application process. 2026 funding round closed; next funding round expected in spring 2027.
